subject: Liquor License Approvals and Rule Enforcement
overview: The commission approved multiple one-day licenses for community and sporting events and authorized a change of stock interest for a local business. The board also discussed the necessity of strictly enforcing the 48-hour agenda deadline for all future applications to ensure compliance with state law.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from January 11 and February 21, 2024.

items.title: Enforcement of 48-Hour Agenda Rule
items.summary: Discussed the requirement for all license applications to be submitted in time for the 48-hour agenda posting deadline and proposed setting a Friday cutoff for future meetings.

items.title: Medford Public Library One-Day License
items.summary: Approved a one-day beer and wine license for a trivia night fundraiser on May 4.

items.title: Ocean State Job Lot Manager Change Documentation
items.summary: Approved a Department of Unemployment Assistance certificate for Ocean State Job Lot to finalize a previously authorized change of manager.

items.title: St. Raphael's Parish One-Day License
items.summary: Approved a one-day alcohol license for a parish fundraiser and raffle event on April 5.

items.title: Boston Glory Sporting Event Licenses
items.summary: Approved six one-day licenses for professional ultimate frisbee games at Hormel Stadium between April and June, noting that alcohol consumption will be restricted to a designated section of the stands.

items.title: Event Them One-Day License
items.summary: Approved a one-day license for a FIFA video game event at 344 Salem Street on April 14.

items.title: Tufts Catering Senior Bingo License
items.summary: Approved a one-day license for a student bingo event, correcting the scheduled date to March 28.

items.title: Semolina Kitchen Change of Stock Interest
items.summary: Approved a change of stock interest for Semolina Kitchen contingent upon the applicant providing an updated, unexpired DUA certificate.
